originStory.title: The Content Creator's Nightmare
originStory.subtitle: Why I Built This System
originStory.story:
For years, I lived the content creator's nightmare. Great ideas would strike at random moments – in the shower, during walks, while reading. I'd jot them down somewhere. Anywhere.

Then when it came time to create? Gone. Lost in a maze of apps, notebooks, and forgotten bookmarks. I'd stare at the blank page, knowing I had something brilliant somewhere, but unable to find it.

The worst part? Starting from scratch every single time. No building on previous work. No connecting ideas. Just the blank page and me, fighting the same battle over and over.

After years of trial and error, I cracked the code. I built a system that captures everything, connects my thinking, and serves up content ideas on demand. Now I never face the blank page – I face an abundance of connected ideas waiting to become content.

This course teaches you exactly how to build that system for yourself.

creatorJourney.title: From Content Struggle to Content Machine
creatorJourney.subtitle: A Creator Who Understands Creators
creatorJourney.story:
I create content every single day. Newsletter editions, articles, social posts, courses, videos. My system isn't theoretical – it's the engine behind everything I publish.

With over 10,000 notes in my knowledge base, I never run out of ideas. Every book I read, every insight I capture, every connection I make – it all feeds into a content creation machine that generates ideas faster than I can publish them.

I've coached hundreds of professionals on knowledge management, and I've seen the transformation when creators finally build a system that works. The anxiety disappears. The consistency appears. And the quality? It compounds.
